crops.feature: lamp cluster, right side as seen head-on (train's left)
crops.reading: One black figure-of-eight (peanut) bezel, bolted rim, not two separate housings: small round red LED tail inboard and lower (centre u 920, v 967, r 29 px), larger clear faceted headlamp outboard and higher (u 1012, v 943, r 43 px). Settled against an earlier reading, 'two separate round lamps': both readers and f-panel-r-164/f-lamps-205/f-lamps-133/f-lamps-302 all show one peanut housing.
crops.reading2: One black peanut housing, screws round the rim; smaller red LED lamp inboard and lower, larger clear headlamp outboard (right) and higher; dia 0.20 W vs 0.33 W.

crops.feature: lamp cluster, left side as seen head-on
crops.reading: Mirror of the right: one peanut bezel, headlamp outboard (left) and higher (u 282, v 909, r 40 px), red LED tail inboard and lower (u 354, v 938, partly hidden by a bracket).
crops.reading2: One peanut housing; larger clear headlamp outboard (left) and higher, smaller red LED inboard and lower; a bracket intrudes lower right.

crops.feature: yellow warning panel under the right screen, its lower edge
crops.reading: Yellow from the screen sill down past the bezel; number '387 164' black above the bezel. Lower edge: nearly level (falling slightly outboard) to its lowest point under the headlamp, then a large-radius corner rising into the near-vertical outer edge. No 'wave' beyond that dip-then-rise; settled on yellow-mask columns (trace face.panels).
crops.reading2: Number across the top; peanut housing in the lower half; bottom edge roughly flat then the outer corner a large convex sweep (radius ~0.2 W) rising to the outer edge; lowest point near the headlamp.

crops.feature: yellow warning panel under the left screen
crops.reading: Same as the right, mirrored: outer edge vertical to about lamp-centre height, then a large convex corner down to the lowest point under the headlamp, then level inboard.
crops.reading2: Left edge straight down to ~0.78 then a smooth convex curve to the bottom at ~0.35 W, then flat; corner radius large (~0.3 W).

crops.reading: Tall pane in a black frame, outer top corner rounded; grey LED destination display in the top of the pane, from the inner edge out to ~2/3 across; deep black sill with the wiper base; wiper pivots low near the inner side and parks up the inner (gangway) edge.
crops.reading2: Black frame, top outer corner small radius; destination display upper area 0.50-0.92 x 0.13-0.29; wiper pivot bottom right (inboard), arm up toward the inboard edge; sill/hose at the bottom.

crops.reading: Tall pane, black frame, top corners rounded (outer slightly more), thick black sill carrying the wiper base; no destination display on this side; wiper parked up the inner edge.
crops.reading2: Large dark pane, slightly rounded corners, top-right bigger; wiper pivot lower left (inboard), parked near vertical; no destination display.

crops.feature: yellow over the screens, orange line
crops.reading: Yellow cap over each screen, its top a convex arc highest beside the gangway frame and rounding down at the outer corner; thin orange line under it; dark grey/black roof dome over; gangway frame top black, rounded, scuffed silver.
crops.reading2: Mustard band each side of the gangway frame, top a convex arc rising towards the gangway, outboard ends curving down; thin orange line beneath; frame top black with large rounded corners.

crops.reading: Yellow two-leaf door, centre seam, hinge rows near each outer edge, two recessed handles at mid height; door very slightly narrower at the top; dark charcoal riveted frame, top corners heavily rounded, bottom square with grey plates; grey bellows ribs on the near side.
crops.reading2: Plain yellow door, slight taper to the top, centre seam at 0.47, hinge knuckles at 0.31 and 0.62, handles at ~0.54 H; charcoal riveted frame, top corners rounded ~0.1 W, bottom square; grey ribbed bellows on the right.

crops.reading2: Orange line curving at top; black mirror housing; framed window; door with slit window; round filler cap; vertical grab slot; small lamp at the bottom.

crops.reading: Seen from the near side at 2025: yellow panel with '387 145', the peanut bezel with the tail lit red, grey bellows and the gangway door's frame standing proud of the face.

crops.reading2: Small rounded cab side window; cab door with tall window and transom; orange line at top; white/silver stripe low down with green below.

crops.reading2: Two separate windows, rounded frames; left narrow, right ~2x wider; green pillar between.

crops.reading2: Two silver-grey leaves, curved seam, one tall narrow window each in the upper middle; lime-green stripe across both at ~0.70; pale grey line on the body either side.

crops.feature: GWR logo, cab car left side
crops.reading: Grey 'GWR' letters, the W drawn as a tall V with a separate slash; V tips rise above the letters to the bodyside line, which stops either side of the logo. G at the front (left as seen). Under window b, ahead of door 1.

crops.feature: 'Great Western Railway' text, cab car left side
crops.reading: Small grey italic serif 'Great Western Railway' tucked right under the grey bodyside line, starting just behind door 1.

crops.feature: GWR logo, cab car right side
crops.reading: Only the 'R' end of the GWR logo in frame at the left edge, under window b: the R is the front end on the right side, so the logo reads normally (G at the rear).

crops.feature: second GWR logo, cab car rear
crops.reading: A second grey GWR logo behind door 2, under the pillar between windows 7 and 8, same size as the front one.
Grey GWR logo on the second car ahead of its door 1, under its second window; a second one is faintly visible behind its door 2.

crops.feature: Great Northern logo, cab car left side
crops.reading: Dark purple box with white 'Great Northern', a light-blue downward triangle hanging under its right-hand (rear) part. Below window 5/6, nearer door 2.

crops.feature: Great Northern logo, cab car right side
crops.reading: Same box and triangle on the right side, in shade (reads greyish); triangle under the right-hand (front) part as seen.
Faint purple box under windows 4-5 of the second car, triangle below; heavily foreshortened.

crops.feature: GX letters, cab car left side
crops.reading: Huge white serif 'GX' from just under the orange line to below the windows; the black window band covers their middle, so only the tops and feet show. G starts over window 3. The white bodyside line stops at the G and restarts after the text.
White spaced capitals 'GATWICK EXPRESS' at the height of the white line (the line is broken for it), from the X's foot almost to door 2.

crops.feature: GX letters and text, cab car left side (second view)
crops.reading: Same large GX with GATWICK EXPRESS after it, between door 1 and door 2 on 387227.

crops.feature: GX logo, cab car right side
crops.reading: On the right side the cab car carries a SMALL GX (only below the windows, about 0.4 m tall) with GATWICK EXPRESS after it, reading normally, so the GX is toward door 2 and the text runs forward to window 4.

crops.feature: GX letters, next car right side
crops.reading: The second car's right side has the large GX (tops above the windows, feet below) with GATWICK EXPRESS after it, reading normally: G toward the car's rear.

crops.feature: GX letters on a Southern-worked unit, 2025-11
crops.reading: 387222 on a Southern service still carries the large GX and GATWICK EXPRESS on the cab car.
Cab car left side red with no GX letters and no white bodyside line; only one small white wordmark ahead of door 2 (illegible at 1600 px, likely Southern's).
White GX strokes visible behind door 1 at Havant on 2026-05-15: the GX branding is still on.

crops.feature: Heathrow Express roundel on door 1 leaves
crops.reading: Each door 1 leaf carries a near-black ring with an hourglass X, and 'Heathrow / Express' in two small lines under it, centred on the leaf.

crops.feature: Heathrow Express roundel on door 2 leaves
crops.reading: Same roundel and text on both door 2 leaves.
White line art: a skyline and a pagoda with 'TOKYO' in capitals, underlined, on the purple panel under window b. Per unit (387132 has NEW YORK).
A large grey stylised aircraft seen from above, nose down-right, on the purple panel under windows 4-5.
Dark grey roundel with 'Heathrow Express' beside it on the grey bodyside behind door 2 (rear of the cab car).
White 'BUSINESS FIRST' capitals along the bottom of the glass of window b; the same vinyl on windows 3-6 and on the door 1 leaf windows.

crops.feature: Heathrow Express roundel on the gangway door
crops.reading: White ring with the hourglass X on the black upper gangway door (the ring is already a faceShape; the X inside is not).

crops.feature: c2c wordmark, cab car left side
crops.reading: Magenta lower-case 'c2c', the 2 dropping below the c's, under window 5, between the doors.

crops.feature: c2c wordmark, cab car right side
crops.reading: Same c2c wordmark under the windows between the doors (night, overexposed).

crops.feature: Quiet Zone door panels, door 1, left side
crops.reading: White rectangles with teal 'Quiet' (front leaf) and 'Zone' (rear leaf) just under the leaf windows; door 2 the same. 387302's right side door 1 has none (Quiet Zone end only).
A small grey/red mark with tiny text behind the c2c wordmark, near door 2: the Trenitalia endorsement (c2c's owner then).
Small red emblem with grey text, behind door 1, lower than the c2c wordmark.
